adj. 可用的；行得通的；可实行的
例句：The only practicable course of action is to sell the company.
唯一可行的做法是把公司卖掉。
例句：It is their duty to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the equipment is safe.
在力所能及的情况下确保设备安全是他们的职责。
